items.label: la main
items.scene: A MAN ("MAN") in a tracksuit waves a giant yellow foam HAND above his head as he cheers on the patients.

items.label: la jambe
items.scene: A girl stretches one LEG along a bench; her sock is smeared with golden apricot JAM ("ZHAHNB") from the open jar, and a bee is curious.

items.label: l'épaule
items.scene: A parrot perches on a sailor's SHOULDER ("ay-POHL") as if on A POLE, both doing shoulder rolls.

items.label: le corps
items.scene: A giant apple CORE ("KOR") with arms and legs does a big stretch, its whole BODY bending like a gymnast.

items.label: le pied
items.scene: The physio stands with one bare FOOT right beside an apple PIE ("PYAY") left on the gym floor, and gasps.

items.label: le bras
items.scene: A strongman curls a shiny BRASS ("BRAH") kettlebell with one huge ARM, muscles bulging.

items.label: le dos
items.scene: A baker in a white hat carries a giant lump of DOUGH ("DOH") on his BACK, bending under its weight on the mat.

items.label: le genou
items.scene: A shaggy GNU ("zhuh-NOO") kneels on one KNEE on the mat and offers a daisy to another gnu.
